Q1.rationale: Clause 3 bars disclosing Confidential Information to any third party, which covers government agencies, and the only carve-out (clause 5, segment 10) is for disclosure required by law or a competent authority, not for reports of possible violations, so no exception for such reports exists.
Q1.label: Entailment

Q2.rationale: V2 only replaces the governing-law clause (segment 14), so clause 3 (segment 6) still bars disclosure to third parties, and the only carve-out (segment 10) covers legally required disclosure, not reports of possible violations.
Q2.label: Entailment
